subject: literacy
concept: Writing a full literary research essay analyzing a historical literary movement's reflection of its era, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a movement/historical-context/textual-evidence organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a full essay analyzing how a literary movement reflects its historical era, using textual evidence from at least one work

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay connects specific textual evidence to specific historical context in support of a clear thesis
misconception_flags: describes the historical period and the literary work separately without connecting them into one argument

interest_binding: movement/work generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
